lead_headline: Shuck Brothers oyster bar opens Saturday at Avanti as foreclosure filings slip 19% week-over-week to 34 cases

restaurant.blurb: 3 new leads today lift active count to 70 (34 openings, 36 closures)—first time closure inventory cracks majority in six days. Saturday's additions: Shuck Brothers launches permanent Avanti stall (mobile oyster bar's first brick-and-mortar after years catering), 7-Eleven at 5090 Federal flags August closure (commercial lease listing confirms), while yesterday's Roll It Up Sushi carry-forward rounds tally. Opening concentration shifts north: Chaffee Park/Thornton corridor accumulates third lead in four days (KIKIS corns 2, China BBQ, now 7-Eleven closure), breaking Union Station's 10-day dominance. Week's 70-lead inventory spans 34 openings (Vaultaire listening bar, FiNO Mediterranean, Paperboy Austin brunch invasion) vs 36 closures (Super Mega Bien RiNo staple, Aspen Baking sudden shutdown, Your Mom's House tax seizure). Geographic churn accelerates: Union Station posts six opening detections since March 4 while Cherry Creek/Capitol Hill shoulder four closures in parallel window.

foreclosure.blurb: 34 filings this week retreat 19% from prior week's 42, dropping below March's 40-case average—top case hits $686K in Arapahoe (24296 E Ohio), well shy of last week's $57M outlier that inflated valuations.

liquor.blurb: Zero applications today extend March's statewide blackout to 28 consecutive days—now 133% longer than any prior gap in tracker history. April 1 quarterly deadline watch: if silence persists past Tuesday, confirms database lag vs genuine demand collapse across Denver metro's 12,300-case archive.

reputation.blurb: 1 mention today (Instagram soccer team financing announcement) caps 58-pickup week—up 38% from prior week's 42, marking March's third consecutive weekly gain. Denver Post drops to 16 citations (28% share, yielding ground to social platforms), while instagram.com delivers 11 and x.com/Facebook combine for 11. Top stories: Cripple Creek retail expansion, Raices developer play, dining roundup coverage. Source fragmentation accelerates—top outlet falls to lowest share since tracker launch as direct social pickups (x.com, Instagram, Facebook) claim 38% of weekly volume vs Post's shrinking dominance.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (1 new, 0 canceled) pushes MTD to +56 (+2.1/day), 90-day cumulative to +124 (+1.3/day). Last 7 days deliver +22 net (29 new, 7 canceled)—maintaining prior week's +17 momentum with 29% higher acquisition velocity (4.1/day vs 3.3) while churn creeps to 1.0/day from 0.9. Two-week pattern firms: daily new subscriber flow sustains 4+/day since mid-March (13 of 15 days hit threshold), offsetting retention slip that stabilizes near 1 cancellation daily. March tracks toward +58 net if final three days match current pace—would mark 38% gain over February despite deceleration from early-month 2.5/day peaks as March 18-20 churn spike (3-2-1 cancellations) crimped upside.
